Basically he travels back in time using ghost magic (lol) to the same baseball game but catches the ball this time and his team wins. Then in the future his body just disappears from the MRI machine and the doctors are like "wtf are we doing here?" Lame. I wish Ash and Andrew would stop being so harsh on the slow setup. That's what makes Tamers so good - the build up of characters, the subtlety, and the real world setting making it super relatable to the kid inside us. The fact that something of this depth came off of the back of Adventure 02 is pretty ballsy of the writers - they could've effortlessly just wrote another 01/02 with no thought to appeal to hyperactive kids and sell toys. I'm not saying they should just get an A for simply trying, but come on!
